Market today: The overall market is soaring, but AMD's stock falling despite strong chip sales sends a mixed signal for your concentrated tech/chip book. A prominent bearish call from Michael Burry adds a layer of caution. 

Your holdings: SOXL (-45.03%) and SPAL (-47.87%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning drawdowns are amplified, especially on margin. SMH is also down nearly 10%. 

Watch: Keep a very close eye on your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) and their stops. Also, watch how the broader chip sector reacts to AMD's mixed signal. 

Bottom line: Aggressive risk management on your leveraged, losing positions is paramount right now.
plays: SOXL: Given the "SELL" status and -45.03% loss on this leveraged ETF, consider trimming or setting a tighter, realistic stop to protect capital.
SPAL: This new, leveraged position is down -47.87%. Review its stop and consider reducing exposure due to its volatility and significant loss.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market has conflicting signals, and managing existing risk is the priority.
